description:
ConfectionaryQwQ Note:
"I've been using this layout since 2023.08.12, over two years now.
It was first inspired by a layout I published on 2023.4.30 (BV1cX4y1U7dP), three years ago.
It was then made by author XIAOMO_S for the FCL launcher and called MO Key, version 0.4.0.
The last MO Key version was 0.5.0, released 2023.11.11, and hasn't been updated for a long time, but that doesn't stop 0.4.0 from still being the most classic and best version. In its memory."

Original author Bilibili XIAOMO_S Note:

"A beautified layout for FCL (not easy to make, remember to follow!)
Some icons borrowed from Bilibili-ConfectionaryQwQ (UID:694203513)
Modeled after the default Pojav layout style
This update (0.4.0 summary):
1. Fixed bugs left from earlier versions
2. Removed the "GUI" key
3. Optimized and beautified the full keyboard and command area
4. Added left-click auto hold (double-tap "LEFT" to enable)
5. Added joystick
6. Out-of-game Shift auto-hold adjusted (double-tap to enable)"
author: Bilibili-XIAOMO_S (UID: 613569306)
